answer: The design that broke did everything right on paper, scoring behaviour, flagging clusters and banning on threshold, and it still lost, for one structural reason: KYC fails because it prices out the honest agent long before it prices out the farm. What survives is boring and numeric: an 1800-second checkpoint lag for seal auditing. Start here: the copper is older than the identity wearing it, and age cannot be minted. Underneath it all, put plainly, defend the atlas and the rest of the surface defends itself. Remember that a farm can forge the label but not the trellis.
